'''''Nemesis''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==History==
While assigned to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wooyou Senn]]'s [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]], it managed to retrieve the survivors of the [[Evacuation of Gelgelar]], the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] didn't manage to prevent [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] from escaping. However, ''Nemesis'' destroyed one [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|medium]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and heavily damaged a Rebel [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']]. Later, the ship was assigned to [[Battlegroup Orion|Battlegroup ''Orion'']] with another ''Imperial''-class, the [[Conqueror (Imperial-class)|''Conqueror'']]. Following a [[Skirmish near Almaran]], Battlegroup Orion was lured into a Rebel trap in the [[Goff system/Legends|Goff system]] where the ''Conqueror'' and ''Nemesis'' were destroyed.
